title_tag: 10 Best Hotels Near Dubai Airport (2026): Prices Compared
meta_description: Hotels near Dubai Airport (DXB) from €52 to €278 a night compared on distance to Terminal 3, free shuttles, check-out times, breakfast and room size.
h1_main: 10 Best Hotels Near Dubai Airport (DXB) in 2026
author_role: 10 hotels near Dubai International compared on distance to the terminals, shuttle, check-out time, price and guest score
lead: For most layovers and night flights, book Premier Inn Dubai International Airport at €52 a night: it faces Terminal 3, runs a free shuttle every 30 minutes and lets you check out from 01:00. For a five-star on the airport doorstep, Le Méridien Dubai is €161 with five pools; Holiday Inn Express (€66) includes breakfast and check-out until 14:00, and families do best at Holiday Inn & Suites Festival City (€149), where kids eat free.

The catch: only three of the ten are within a kilometre of the terminals, and only four list an airport shuttle. The rest sit 2–3 km away in Garhoud, Port Saeed and Festival City, a short taxi ride. All 10 were compared on distance to DXB, shuttle, check-in and check-out times, price for the same night, guest score, room size and breakfast. Filter by shuttle, metro, 5★, families or budget below, or jump to the comparison table.
price_note: Lowest nightly rate for 2 adults on 13–14 January 2027. Dates, room type and board change it; taxes and the Dubai tourism fee are added at booking.

review: Premier Inn is the default pick for almost any short stop at DXB. At €52 a night it is the cheapest of the ten, it sits on 52B Street opposite Terminal 3, and the free shuttle runs every 30 minutes between the hotel and Terminal 3. That combination, plus a guest score of 8.7 from more than 22,000 reviews, is why it ranks first.

The house rules suit flight times better than any other hotel here: check-out runs from 01:00 to 12:00, so a 03:00 departure does not cost you a second night, and the front desk, gym and Costa Coffee all run 24 hours. Upstairs there is a heated rooftop pool and hot tub looking towards Downtown Dubai.

Compared with Holiday Inn Express (#3), which is just as close, Premier Inn scores almost a full point higher (8.7 vs 7.8) and adds the pool; Holiday Inn Express wins on breakfast included and a check-out that runs to 14:00. If you want a five-star with gardens and five pools, Le Méridien (#2) is the same distance away for about three times the price.

The catches: the shuttle only drops off at Terminal 1, so arriving there means a taxi; rooms are a compact 258 ft² (24 m²); and check-in closes at 23:30, so tell the hotel if you land later. Breakfast is €14. Taxes come on top: a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and an AED 10 tourism fee per night.

review: Le Méridien is the answer when you want the airport's convenience without a transit-hotel feel. For €161 a night you get a five-star on Airport Road in Garhoud, 0.5 miles from DXB, set in landscaped gardens with five heated pools, the Natural Elements Spa and 12 restaurants.

That makes it the best place on this list to turn a 10- or 12-hour layover into a short holiday: a swim, a spa treatment, teppanyaki at Kiku or pizza at Casa Mia, and a 32 m² garden-view room with a patio and bathtub. Guests rate comfort and staff 9.2 and location 9.1.

Compared with Marriott Marquis (#8) it is €36 cheaper and much closer to the terminals; compared with Premier Inn (#1) it costs three times as much but gives you a resort instead of a rooftop pool. The lowest rate comes with free cancellation and no prepayment.

The catch for a stopover: there is no airport shuttle in the listing and the rules are a standard 15:00 check-in and 12:00 check-out, so an evening flight means a long afternoon in the lobby. review: Holiday Inn Express is the practical pick for budget travellers who want breakfast in the price. The €66 rate includes a hot buffet breakfast, the hotel stands on Airport Road opposite Terminal 3, and a free airport shuttle is listed. Emirates Metro Station is a short walk away.
Its real edge is the clock: check-out runs until 14:00, two hours later than every other hotel here, which matters if your flight leaves mid-afternoon. Check-in starts at 14:00.

Against Premier Inn (#1) next door, it loses on guest score (7.8 vs 8.7) and has no pool, but Premier Inn's breakfast-included rates start at €100, so if breakfast matters Holiday Inn Express is the cheaper of the two. review: Marriott Marquis Dubai Creek is the most polished stay here and the highest-rated of the ten (8.9), with 9.3 for comfort. It sits at Jewel of the Creek in Port Saeed, 3 km from the airport, and the lowest rate (€197) comes with free cancellation and pay at the property.

Room rates include a free daily shuttle to DCC Mall and Kite Beach, which turns a stopover into an easy beach afternoon. On site there is a heated pool with a pool bar and kids' pool, a hot tub, sauna and spa, and four restaurants including Creek Kitchen and The Copperhead.

It also solves two problems no one else here does: pets are allowed on request, and there is no minimum check-in age. Compared with Le Méridien (#2), you pay €36 more for a higher score but sit further from the terminals.

The catches: no airport shuttle is listed, breakfast is €36 on room-only rates (refundable breakfast rates from €221), and cash is not accepted. Taxes come on top (10% service charge, 5% VAT, 7% municipality fee, AED 20 tourism fee per night).

review: Flora Creek is the stay for space per euro. The cheapest unit is a 743 ft² (69 m²) studio apartment with a full kitchen, balcony and creek or landmark views for €115 a night at the member price (free sign-in), with free cancellation and nothing to pay until arrival. That is almost three times the size of the airport hotel rooms.

It is in Port Saeed near Deira City Centre: the mall and metro station are a 5-minute walk and the airport is about 10 minutes' drive. Inside there is an indoor temperature-controlled pool, a gym with sauna and steam bath, the Olive Tree restaurant and a 24-hour front desk.

Compared with Holiday Inn & Suites (#7), it has far more room and a kitchen but fewer things for kids to do; compared with Royal Continental (#6) nearby, it costs €50 more and gives you an apartment instead of a hotel room.

guide.h2: Dubai Airport Hotels Compared: Distance, Shuttle, Check-out and Price
guide.html:
All ten prices are the lowest nightly rate for two adults on the same January weeknight, before taxes. Premier Inn, Millennium and Royal Continental were Black Friday deal rates that night, and Flora Creek's €115 is a members' price after a free sign-in. Distances are from Dubai International (DXB) as listed for each hotel. The two columns that decide most airport stays are the shuttle and the check-out time: only four hotels list an airport shuttle, and only two let you leave outside normal hours.

guide.h2: Which Dubai Airport Hotel Should You Book?
guide.html:
• Layover or night flight: #1 Premier Inn, €52. Opposite Terminal 3, free shuttle every 30 minutes and check-out from 01:00.
  • Afternoon flight on a budget: #3 Holiday Inn Express, €66, with breakfast included and check-out until 14:00.
  • Long layover, want a pool and a proper meal: #4 Millennium, €94 (shuttle to T1 and T3, 38 m² room), or #2 Le Méridien, €161 for five pools and 12 restaurants.
  • Arriving at Terminal 1: #4 Millennium lists a shuttle to both Terminal 1 and 3; Premier Inn only drops off at Terminal 1.
  • A night or two to see Dubai: #5 Aloft, €124, next to City Centre Deira with metro access and a T3 shuttle.
  • Families: #7 Holiday Inn & Suites, €149 (kids eat free, kids' pool), or #10 Crowne Plaza, €278 for free extra beds up to age 12. For space and a kitchen: #9 Flora Creek, €115 member price.
  • Best-rated, or travelling with a pet: #8 Marriott Marquis, €197.
  • Cheapest 4★: #6 Royal Continental, €65, rated 8.8.

Staying longer than a stopover? Our Dubai Creek hotels comparison covers the creekside resorts 4–5 km from the airport, and Downtown Dubai hotels put you under the Burj Khalifa.

guide.h2: Staying Near DXB: Which Area, Getting to the Terminal and Extra Costs
guide.html:
Which side of the airport

  • Garhoud, the terminal side (Premier Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Le Méridien, Millennium): 0.5 miles to 2 km from DXB. Three of the four list a shuttle, and the two 3★ hotels face Terminal 3.
  • Port Saeed and Deira City Centre (Royal Continental, Aloft, Flora Creek, Marriott Marquis): 1.3–1.9 miles out, next to the mall and metro. Better for a night out or a city day.
  • Dubai Festival City (Holiday Inn & Suites, Crowne Plaza): 2–3 km away, connected to Dubai Festival City Mall. Best for families.

Getting to and from the terminal

Premier Inn runs a free shuttle to Terminal 3 every 30 minutes (drop-off only at Terminal 1). Millennium lists a free shuttle to Terminals 1 and 3, Holiday Inn Express a free airport shuttle, and Aloft a scheduled shuttle to Terminal 3. Everyone else is a short taxi ride. By metro, Holiday Inn Express is a short walk from Emirates Metro Station, and Flora Creek is 5 minutes from Deira City Centre station.

Late arrivals and early departures

Check-in starts at 14:00 at Premier Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Millennium and Flora Creek, and 15:00 elsewhere. Most hotels here ask you to tell them your arrival time in advance, and Premier Inn's check-in closes at 23:30, so message the hotel if you land after 23:30. For departures, Premier Inn's check-out window opens at 01:00 and Holiday Inn Express runs to 14:00; everywhere else it is 12:00.

What costs extra

  • Taxes and fees: room prices exclude a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and a Dubai tourism fee of AED 10 (Premier Inn, Holiday Inn Express), AED 15 (Millennium, Aloft, Holiday Inn & Suites) or AED 20 (Le Méridien, Marriott Marquis, Crowne Plaza) per room per night.
  • Breakfast: included at Holiday Inn Express; €14 (Premier Inn), €17 (Aloft), €19 (Holiday Inn & Suites), €20 (Millennium), €28 (Crowne Plaza), €32 (Le Méridien), €36 (Marriott Marquis).
  • Deposits: AED 500 by card at Millennium, AED 300 in cash at Flora Creek.
  • Extra beds: free for under-13s at Crowne Plaza; AED 75–184 a night elsewhere; none at Premier Inn.

Making the most of a layover

With 8 hours or more, you can leave the hotel: compare Dubai city tours, book Burj Khalifa tickets for the observation deck, or take one of the Dubai dinner cruises on the creek. The rates above are for mid-January, the cooler winter season.

faqs.q: What is the best hotel near Dubai Airport?
faqs.a: Premier Inn Dubai International Airport, from €52 a night. It is opposite Terminal 3, runs a free shuttle every 30 minutes, has a rooftop pool and lets you check out from 01:00, with a guest score of 8.7. For a five-star, Le Méridien Dubai (€161) is the same 0.5 miles from the airport with five pools.

faqs.q: Is there a hotel inside Dubai Airport Terminal 3?
faqs.a: Yes: Sleepover (formerly sleep 'n fly) has rooms in Terminal 3 Concourses A, B and C, from about €112 for a 6-hour cabin stay on the same January date, with guest scores of 6.8–7.7. We left them out of the ten because Premier Inn and Holiday Inn Express, opposite Terminal 3 with free shuttles, score higher and sell a full night for less than a 6-hour cabin.

faqs.q: Which Dubai airport hotels have a free shuttle?
faqs.a: Premier Inn (to Terminal 3 every 30 minutes, drop-off only at Terminal 1), Millennium Airport Hotel (Terminals 1 and 3) and Holiday Inn Express. Aloft Dubai Creek lists a scheduled shuttle to Terminal 3. Marriott Marquis's free shuttle goes to DCC Mall and Kite Beach, not the airport.

faqs.q: Can I check out late or very early for my flight?
faqs.a: Premier Inn's check-out window runs from 01:00 to 12:00, which suits night departures, and Holiday Inn Express allows check-out until 14:00. Every other hotel here lists check-out until 12:00.

faqs.q: How much is a hotel near Dubai Airport per night?
faqs.a: For two adults on a January weeknight, the ten here ranged from €52 (Premier Inn) to €278 (Crowne Plaza Festival City), with a median of about €120. A 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and a tourism fee of AED 10–20 per room per night come on top.

faqs.q: Which hotel near DXB is best for families?
faqs.a: Holiday Inn & Suites Dubai Festival City (€149): kids eat free with a paying adult, there is a kids' pool and Family Suites, and it connects to Dubai Festival City Mall. Crowne Plaza next door gives free extra beds up to age 12, and Flora Creek has 69 m² studios with a kitchen.

faqs.q: What can I do in Dubai on a long layover?
faqs.a: From the Port Saeed and Garhoud hotels, Downtown and the creek are a short taxi ride. See our Dubai city tours and Burj Khalifa tickets comparisons to pick something that fits your hours.

methodology: We compared more than 20 hotels around Dubai International Airport on live prices for the same night (two adults, one night in mid-January) and kept the 10 that give a genuinely different choice: transit hotels opposite Terminal 3, a garden five-star, mall hotels in Port Saeed and Festival City, and serviced apartments, from €52 to €278. Each was scored first on how easily you reach the terminals (distance, airport shuttle, check-in and check-out times, metro), then on guest and location score, room size, pool, breakfast cost and family policies.
